description: Splits a clip into Drums/Bass/Other/Vocals tracks with the Demucs (htdemucs) source separator, aligned with the source clip. Slow: minutes for a full song, CPU only. Needs the model weights, which the Audionaut app downloads once (Settings > Separation); fails with model_missing until then, and with demucs_unavailable in builds without Demucs.

clip.description: Playlist item id (default: the track's first clip)

mute_source.description: Mute the source track's channels (default true)

project.description: Path to the .audium project package (absolute paths recommended)

track.description: Track id (default 0; imported audio lands on a new track)

name: separate_stems
title: Separate stems
